title: 1 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on 1 Chronicles 29: the willing gifts for the temple, David's prayer of praise, Solomon made king, and the end of David's reign.

questions.text: How did David describe his son Solomon to the assembly?
questions.explanation: David said Solomon, whom alone God had chosen, was yet young and tender, and the work was great.

answers.text: Skilled in every kind of building

questions.text: From where was the gold that David gave from his own treasure?
questions.explanation: David gave three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir.

questions.text: What was David's refined silver to be used for?
questions.explanation: David gave seven thousand talents of refined silver with which to overlay the walls of the houses.

answers.text: To overlay the walls of the houses
To make the ark of the covenant
To pay the workers from Tyre
To make a crown for Solomon

questions.text: Under whose hand were the precious stones given to the treasure of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:8 says the precious stones were given under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

questions.text: How much iron did the leaders give for the service of God's house?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:7 says they gave of iron one hundred thousand talents.
1 Chronicles 29:9 says the people rejoiced because they offered willingly, with a perfect heart, to Yahweh.

answers.text: Because the house of God was finished
Because they had won a great battle
Because the king had lowered their taxes
Because they had offered willingly with a perfect heart

questions.text: In his prayer, what did David say their days on the earth are like?
questions.explanation: David said, "Our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no remaining."

questions.text: Who was anointed to be priest when Solomon was made king the second time?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:22 says they anointed Solomon before Yahweh to be prince, and Zadok to be priest.

questions.text: How long did David reign in Hebron?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:27 says David reigned forty years, seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.

questions.text: In whose histories are the acts of David the king written?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 29:29 says they are written in the history of Samuel the seer, of Nathan the prophet, and of Gad the seer.

answers.text: Moses, Joshua, and Samuel the judge
Samuel the seer, Nathan the prophet, and Gad the seer
Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun the singers
Zadok, Abiathar, and Jehiel the priests
